clarification: completed_coverage: 0 is the request starting coverage/cursor, not a count of successfully completed synchronizations. NewConversationSyncRequest deliberately starts every login from zero coverage to request a full sync. RunLoginSync requires CONNECT success, ConversationSync success and ValidateConversationSync success before setting TrafficReady=true/SyncCompleted=true; failed sessions are not admitted to the online pool. Coordinator waits all workers traffic-ready, delivers the first full global grant successfully, then Begin writes run-start. Thus use source-bound startup barrier for configured10000online/2000SEND-per-second; do not call this an independent sustained throughput measurement.
